why: Her drawn sword carry (warden-move, lane A), as targets any body is held to, not as A's joint angles (PIPELINE.md 'Marionette is the pipe'; the owner 16 Nov: 'always keep marionette looped in ... so we can reproduce it'). Two parts. 'pose': the clips' arm read at the den camera (pitch 62, orthographic), per facing psi (0 = facing the camera), from carry_ref_a.json (fr.py on A's judged clips, judges r3-r6 and r9-r10): a body passes when its baked clips (bake keys dump, carry_read.py) read within 'tol' of A's. 'game': the bars the judged game shoots are measured to (t10.py, ana10.py, runsame.py on a DirRun eight-leg shoot's views.log), body-generic.

rules.fist_under_shoulder: fist_dn mean >= 0.05 m at every psi (the fist hangs below her shoulder on screen; the owner 15 Nov: 'locked elbow' is the failure)
rules.elbow_relaxed: elbow_dn >= -0.03 m at psi 0 (the elbow not raised over the shoulder line)

game.T1_prime: no frame with shown >= 0.6 of the blade's length, its tip > 8 px under the lower boot and |screen angle from vertical| < 28 (judge r10, the round 11 cane bar)
game.T3: screen step <= 25 deg per frame unless shown <= 0.5 on both frames; no isolated spike (> 12 and > 2x both neighbours)
game.T4: sword side to the camera: hidden behind the legs <= 3 frames in a row
game.T5: runs +7..+35: blade traces within 3.5 deg of the judged reference shoot (runsame.py)

runtime_body_constants.why: SideCarry and PlayerView constants that depend on the body; re-measured per body from a game shoot (ana10.py 'hd' and the calf columns), kept in the code with the body they were measured on.

measured_on_b.source: calf_radii.py on body_p1 body.glb (knee x0.959, ankle x1.002 of A's); PivotBeta = PIVOT beta0 in the e20/e20s13 views.log (off 21.1-22.5, on -48.2..-52.1), 17 Nov
measured_on_b.decision: the game keeps A's values on B: A's calf is the larger (safer clearance) and the beta deltas (3 deg, 0-2 deg) are far inside the way-round's margin (sweeps of 135-180 deg); TipGround unused while TipFloor is 0
